businesses.business: skilled nursing and senior care operator

offering_description.value: Owns and operates skilled nursing facilities, assisted and independent living communities, memory care units, and home health and hospice agencies. Serves seniors and patients mainly in the southeastern and midwestern US. Revenue comes largely from Medicare and Medicaid reimbursement, plus private pay.

primary_services.value: skilled nursing care; rehabilitation therapy; assisted and independent living; memory care; home health and hospice care

customer_segment.value: B2C: elderly patients and residents and their families, private pay; B2G: Medicare and state Medicaid programs as payers; B2B: private insurers and managed care plans

end_markets.value: senior care; long-term care; post-acute healthcare; home health and hospice

revenue_model.value: healthcare reimbursement: Medicare, Medicaid and insurer payments for nursing, therapy, home health and hospice care; service fees: private-pay charges for assisted living, independent living and nursing care; rental or leasing: leasing of facilities to third-party operators
revenue_model.category: healthcare reimbursement; service fees; rental or leasing

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and operates nursing centers and senior living communities serving patients and residents; service provider: delivers home health, hospice and therapy services to patients

geography_served.value: US regional: Southeastern and midwestern states such as Tennessee, Missouri, South Carolina, Florida, Alabama, Kentucky and Virginia

specialization.value: related lines: skilled nursing, senior living, home health, hospice and rehabilitation services for seniors

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company-operated nursing centers, senior living communities and home health and hospice offices; other: referrals from hospitals and physicians

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Nursing facilities need state licensure, certificate of need and CMS Medicare/Medicaid certification and oversight
